title: Lakehouse: MinIO policy attach (grant) round-trip
description: Runs `nexus acl lakehouse grant --user <key> --permissions readonly --yes`. Attaches the readonly policy to a MinIO user via `mc admin policy attach`, then re-lists to show the change. (Demo against a throwaway user; never a protected identity.)

steps.command: nexus acl lakehouse grant --user nexus-acl-demo --permissions readonly --yes

observe.what: the readonly policy is attached to the user; the refreshed list includes it (verify with mc admin policy entities)

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.AclAsync grant attaches a MinIO policy to a user (mc admin policy attach) and re-lists; revoke detaches it, with the root + app users detach-protected.
